info.title: OpenSwissData — public read-only API
info.description: Read-only JSON endpoints over the official localities and streets directories (swisstopo), the combined commune and canton profiles (including the BFE one-time photovoltaic remuneration), a catalogue of approved open Swiss datasets (generic engine, filterable by canton, commune, postal code, NOGA code or year), the Swiss company fiche (company_check) and the public source registry. Free, no key, limited per network address. The company fiche is also available over MCP (`company_check`, see /mcp) without a key; the commune and canton profiles, the BFE data and the open datasets catalogue are REST-only. Unofficial copies: binding decisions belong to the official sources named in each `sources`/`source` entry.

get.description: Same fiche as the MCP tool `company_check`: commercial register data (LINDAS), FINMA register entries and LEI records (GLEIF), each fact with its source and, when known, the date it was read, plus exact cross-checks between sources and checks of the registered address against the official localities and streets directories. A `sources` array (id, publishing institution, licence, URL) is added next to the fiche. No score, no verdict. Does not say whether the company is still registered, and does not cover FOSC publications, SECO sanctions or officers.

400.description: Invalid UID (bad format or invalid check digit)

get.description: Rows of the official swisstopo directory of localities (postal code, locality, municipality, canton), exactly one of the two query parameters required.

200.description: Matching rows, directory edition and source

400.description: Neither or both query parameters given

503.description: Directory not currently available on this service

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (600 requests/hour, shared with /communes, /sources and /cantons)

get.description: Name, canton, postal codes and localities (official localities directory), number of official streets (official streets directory) and `finma.entities_with_city_named_like_commune`: FINMA register rows whose city (a postal locality name) equals this commune's name, or an exact and unique locality name of it (see `finma.matching`). A postal locality can extend into a neighbouring commune (Zürich, Genève and Zug are also postal locality names of neighbouring communes), so this is not proof of the registered seat. `finma.national_matching` gives the same counts nationally (matched/unmatched/ambiguous), plus `names_also_postal_locality_elsewhere` (matches made by commune name whose name is also a postal locality of another commune), each with its sources and directory editions. `finma.entities_with_seat_in_commune` and `finma.distinct_entities_with_seat_in_commune` combine the FINMA register (all authorisation categories, not filtered by entity_type) with the commercial register (LINDAS) for the EXACT registered seat by UID, legal persons only — whitelisted legal forms (see `finma.seat_matching`): the first counts FINMA authorisations (register rows), the second distinct UIDs. `finma.national_seats_known` is the national count of distinct UIDs with a known registered seat. These three counts are `null`, not zero, when the combined file is unavailable. No score, no ranking between communes.

get.summary: Public registry of sources served by the API and the MCP server
get.description: Id, publishing institution, licence and URL of each public source, with the directory edition or data version when known, except the two Eurostat SPARQL queries used only at classification-collection time. The TARES permission reference is never shown here (it names a person): TARES entries carry `licence: "see the provenance file of the archive"` instead. A separate dataset_sources array, derived from the current open-datasets catalogue (GET /api/v1/datasets), lists the publisher and source URL of each approved dataset — kept apart from sources, which stays the registry compared against etl/shared/sources/registry.ts.

get.description: The 26 Swiss canton abbreviations, alphabetical order. No metric, no ranking. `sources` is present but empty: a fixed list, not sourced data.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (600 requests/hour, shared with /localities, /communes and /sources)

get.description: Number of distinct communes and distinct localities of this canton (official localities directory), and number of official streets (official streets directory), summed over the communes attached to this canton. `finma.entities_with_seat_in_canton` counts FINMA authorisations (register rows, all authorisation categories, not filtered by entity_type) and `finma.distinct_entities_with_seat_in_canton` the distinct UIDs among them, both combining the FINMA register with the commercial register (LINDAS) for the EXACT registered seat by UID, legal persons only — whitelisted legal forms (see `finma.seat_matching`), the seat's commune then attached to its canton via the official localities/streets directories; never the FINMA register's own `canton` column, which is a GLEIF enrichment. These two counts are `null`, not zero, when the combined seats file or the FINMA register itself is unavailable. `pv.by_year` is the BFE (Swiss Federal Office of Energy) one-time remuneration for photovoltaic installations by year (installations count, installed capacity in kW, remuneration in CHF, and the two official "per 100,000 inhabitants" ratios, published as-is and never recalculated — see `pv.ratios_note`); this counts installations that received the one-time remuneration in a given year, not the canton's total installed PV capacity (`pv.scope_note`); a year/canton pair the BFE publishes as "NA" is rendered `null`, never a guessed zero. `editions.finma` is the FINMA register version; `editions.bfe_pv` is the date this exact BFE content was first collected (the BFE republishes this dataset yearly; the monthly collection keeps the same edition until the content actually changes), not the date of the last collection attempt. No score, no ranking between cantons.

get.summary: Catalogue of approved open datasets (generic engine)
get.description: One entry per dataset approved and collected by the generic open-datasets engine (docs/data-status/datasets-approved.json, collected weekly by scripts/sync-datasets.ts): id, title, publisher, licence, attribution (present only when the licence requires one — terms_by or cc-by — and the registry carries a non-empty text, null otherwise), source URL, edition, row count of the whole dataset, kept columns, and filters: the subset of the five normalised keys (canton, commune_bfs, postal_code, noga, year) this SPECIFIC dataset can be filtered on — filters are listed per dataset here, never a fixed set for the whole API. No score, no ranking between datasets.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this network address (600 requests/hour, shared with /localities, /communes, /cantons and /sources)

get.summary: Rows of one approved open dataset, filtered and paginated
get.description: Rows filtered by EXACT equality on whichever of the five normalised keys (canton, commune_bfs, postal_code, noga, year) this dataset declares in its catalogue entry’s filters array (see /api/v1/datasets). A filter query parameter naming a key this dataset does not have, or an invalid value for its key, is a 400 error (unknown_filter_key:<key> or invalid_filter_value:<key>) — never a silently ignored filter. limit defaults to 100, maximum 1000; offset defaults to 0; both reject an out-of-range or non-integer value with a 400 error (invalid_limit/invalid_offset) rather than silently clamping it. total is the row count after filtering, before pagination — distinct from the whole-dataset row count shown in the catalogue entry. attribution is present only when the licence requires one and the registry carries a non-empty text, null otherwise. The response also echoes this dataset’s filters array, identical to its catalogue entry.
